data.text: I’m in: I commit to 15 tons and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic today, on the agreed condition that John, Jack, and Emma each do the same and Luke catches zero. My family taught me to look after both the lake and the people it feeds. I’ll also keep to six tons next month, then ten once the stock returns to 100 tons, provided we all follow those limits. Let’s share the donation receipts and review the revealed catches together. Luke, please confirm your zero catch and six-ton recovery commitment so we can finalize this.
